Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[John Kerry]] was reelected to his second term. This was the first time a Democrat was re-elected to this Senate seat. ==Republican primary == ===Candidates === * [[Jim Rappaport]], real estate developer * Daniel W.
